query:
SELECT 
  u.email, u.name, u.tokenBalance, u.createdAt as userCreated,
  t.amount, t.reason, t.description, t.balanceAfter, t.createdAt as txDate
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN token_transactions t ON t.appUserId = u.id
WHERE u.email LIKE '%8822705%'
ORDER BY t.createdAt ASC;
